15 navanbar 2000 ko jab bihar se alag hokar jharkhand rajy astitv men aaya, tab iske pichhe keval ek nae rajy ke gathan ki mang nahin thi. is aandolan ki buniyad aadivasi asmita, sanskritik pahchan, svashasan aur jal, jangal va jamin par adhikar ki laraee thi.
